name: Content first
summary: Large, calm type and generous space, for people who come to read.
description: Content first is an Open DS scheme: a full set of answers to the Open DS grammar, with the reasons behind each, usage rules, voice and tone, and the tokens that follow. Large, calm type and generous space, for people who come to read.
